title.narrative: Developing an Inclusive Education Environment for Children with and without Disabilities in the Gaza strip

description.narrative: Overall goal: Contributing towards building an inclusive society with equal access to inclusive education and accessible health services for people with and without disabilities in Palestine. Specific Objective: The right of children with and without disabilities to inclusive education and health services based on a national disability-inclusive framework is promoted and supported by the community in the Gaza strip
